executed_failure.meaning: The comparator rejects a FLEURS WAV encoded as WAVE_FORMAT_IEEE_FLOAT (format tag 3) before Nemotron transcription starts. Python stdlib wave does not accept this input encoding.

root_cause.cause: Fixture validation assumes stdlib-wave-readable PCM WAV while the pinned FLEURS source bytes can be IEEE-float WAV. The harness therefore fails before the claimed ASR discriminator is exercised.

existing_contract_conflict.note: Even a successful rerun remains non-promotable until the controller receipt envelope is reconciled with the current F2 fail-closed validator contract without rewriting measured facts.

repair_constraint.preferred: Reuse the already-installed soundfile decoder to inspect/decode float WAV and produce an explicit deterministic mono 16 kHz PCM16 derived fixture only if this preserves the admitted ASR004 comparison semantics.
required_provenance: fail closed if sample rate/channel assumptions differ
do not silently claim the normalized bytes are identical to ASR004 fixtures
repair_constraint.comparison_fence: If ASR004 baselines were measured on materially different fixture bytes or preprocessing, baseline comparability must be re-established before quality conclusions.

next_exact_action: Repair only the fixture decode/normalization boundary with explicit dual source/derived hashes, preserve ASR004 comparison semantics, reconcile the receipt contract, then execute one nonduplicate bound comparator run on vps-clay-host. Classify the resulting execution independently; do not mint runtime or quality credit from this failure.
scope_fence: This records exact executable counterevidence against the ASR008 harness validity only. It is not evidence that Nemotron itself failed, and it does not authorize broader product/runtime/training credit.
